recorded_controls.name: The rotor gap scale restores the stated four-link Wilson kinetic normalization

recorded_controls.name: Damping the compact trial absorbs the complete shared-link residual algebra

recorded_controls.name: A complete boundary link carries the exact Haar Casimir and growing rank budget
recorded_controls.detail: The fundamental Haar coordinate has Rayleigh quotient 3, and SU2 degrees 0 through N have dimension (N+1)(N+2)(2N+3)/6.
